run_objectnav_evaluation: run an object navigation evaluation episode in the Habitat HM3D simulator with a configured agent
create_video_from_images: create an MP4 video from a list of OpenCV images at a specified frame rate
run_agent_in_environment: run an ObjectNavAgent loop in a HabitatObjectNavEnv episode until completion and print metrics
review_create_video: review the create_video function that writes a list of images to an MP4 file using cv2
refactor_evaluation_loop: refactor the evaluation while loop to support multiple environments or custom action logging
